:::{#def-adaptive-method}
#### Adaptive method

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have first [partial derivatives](vector-calculus.qmd#def-partial-derivative),
let $\vx^{(0)}$ be a starting point,
let $\steplen > 0$ be a [step length](#def-gradient-descent),
let $\rho \in [0, 1)$ be a decay factor,
and let $\epsilon > 0$.
Write $g_j^{(t)}$ for coordinate $j$ of $\deriv{\vx} f(\vx^{(t-1)})$.
An **adaptive method** computes, for $t = 1, 2, \ldots$ and each coordinate $j = 1, \ldots, p$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
u_j^{(t)} &\eqdef \rho\,u_j^{(t-1)} + (1 - \rho)\,\paren{g_j^{(t)}}^2 \\
x_j^{(t)} &\eqdef x_j^{(t-1)} - \steplen\,\frac{g_j^{(t)}}{\sqrt{u_j^{(t)}} + \epsilon},
\end{aligned}
$$

with $u_j^{(0)} \eqdef 0$.

:::
